lines.t:
Aimshot preps slower than a normal
attack and misses more, but...

If it hits, <c:ff00ff>the foe can't defend or evade<c>
and <c:ff00ff>the targeted slot takes sure {{damage}}<c>.

Pinpoint-{{destroy}} {{part|pl}} with nasty
actions or thin armor...

Use it to land a sure hit on a {{medabot}}
that excels at {{defend}} or {{evade}}!

After an all-out attack,
recovering its stance takes time.

In other words, during {{cooldown}}
it can't defend or evade.

A hit in this state is always
a {{critical}} and does heavy {{damage}}.

Very strong, but very risky.
Use it when you're safe in {{cooldown}}.
